verdict.rationale: v0's own marketing documents a live preview alongside visual controls during building, and its docs describe preview deployments from working branches before publishing through pull requests. That covers previewing before going live, but no evidence says the live preview is interactive (clicking through flows, using the running app), and no independent or hands-on report confirms it. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the in-builder preview is interactive and runs the live app, detail on the preview-while-building workflow beyond a one-line marketing claim, independent or hands-on corroboration of the live preview experience

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing

citations.quote: Fine-tune every detail with visual controls and live preview.
Preview deployments are built from working branches.
work on isolated branches, preview changes, run CI, and publish through pull requests
